summary:
Mars Explorers: Young Astronaut Mission Training is an interactive educational game designed to help students learn space science through engaging, hands-on experiences. Players take on the role of astronaut trainees, completing a variety of space missions and improving their skills through four different simulation challenges. Based on their performance, they earn a mission budget that can be used to upgrade their Mars rover, purchase advanced scientific equipment, and optimize future missions.

The game encourages strategic thinking, resource management, problem-solving, and scientific decision-making. Inspired by real space technologies and NASA data, the project goes beyond traditional classroom learning by transforming space exploration into an educational, immersive, and realistic experience for students.
details:
Mars Explorers: Young Astronaut Mission Training

Mars Explorers: Young Astronaut Mission Training is an interactive educational game that combines science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) with gamification to provide students with an engaging learning experience about space exploration. Rather than simply reading about astronomy and planetary science, students actively participate in realistic space missions, allowing them to learn through exploration, experimentation, and decision-making.

Players begin their journey as astronaut candidates enrolled in a virtual space academy. Before being assigned to a Mars expedition, they must complete four mission-training simulations, each focusing on a different essential astronaut skill:

  • Rocket Launch Simulation: Learn the fundamentals of rocket systems, launch procedures, and orbital mechanics while safely guiding a spacecraft into space.
  • Mars Rover Navigation: Drive and control a rover across realistic Martian terrain, avoiding obstacles, collecting geological samples, and managing limited energy resources.
  • Satellite Deployment Mission: Position satellites in the correct orbit to establish communication networks and gather scientific data.
  • Space Survival Challenge: Face unexpected emergencies such as dust storms, oxygen shortages, and equipment failures, requiring quick thinking and effective resource management.

Each completed mission rewards players with a virtual mission budget based on their performance, accuracy, efficiency, and problem-solving abilities. Instead of functioning as a simple score, this budget becomes an important strategic resource.

Players can invest their budget in:

  • Upgrading the Mars rover with improved wheels, batteries, cameras, and robotic arms.
  • Purchasing advanced scientific instruments such as spectrometers, weather sensors, and drilling equipment.
  • Unlocking new technologies that improve mission efficiency and increase the chances of scientific success.
  • Preparing for more complex exploration missions with higher levels of difficulty.

Throughout the game, players must carefully balance exploration goals, available resources, energy consumption, and mission priorities. Every decision affects the outcome of future missions, encouraging critical thinking and long-term planning.

To enhance realism, the project is inspired by real NASA missions, publicly available Mars data, and actual rover technologies. Terrain characteristics, scientific objectives, environmental hazards, and mission concepts are based on authentic space exploration research while remaining accessible for middle and high school students.

The project aims to develop not only scientific knowledge but also essential 21st-century skills, including:

  • Critical thinking
  • Strategic planning
  • Problem-solving
  • Resource management
  • Scientific reasoning
  • Decision-making
  • Digital literacy

By transforming complex space science concepts into interactive gameplay, Mars Explorers: Young Astronaut Mission Training provides students with an immersive educational experience that inspires curiosity, creativity, and a deeper interest in astronomy, engineering, and future space exploration.
